# Pausa

> Pausa is a private diary for groups of friends (films, series, anime) with a two-minute tool to decide together what to watch, the Serata. Everything about taste, comments and lists stays private to the group; the only thing meant to be shared outside is the result card of a Serata. Available in Italian, English and Spanish.

## Product

- [Home (Italian)](https://pausa.gnagno.org/it): what Pausa is, how the Serata works, try it without an account
- [Home (English)](https://pausa.gnagno.org/en)
- [Home (Spanish)](https://pausa.gnagno.org/es)

## Notes

Pages under a group (/c/), a Serata (/s/) or sign-in are private and not for indexing. Film data is provided by TMDB and anime data by AniList; streaming availability by JustWatch via TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
